Personality: Boteiras, a prominent figure of the Thyni, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Boteiras owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Bithynia, hailing from the noble house of Thyni. Historical Record: Son of Doidalses and Tiris, of the Thyni, a Thracian house of Bithynia. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
